text: In this unit Alex falls ill and sees a doctor, and later shops and cooks with Max. In this unit you will say what hurts, make a doctor's appointment, understand simple medical advice and ask for medicine. You will also shop for food at a market and a supermarket, and talk about healthy habits. The scenes are set in places you may know: a surgery, a pharmacy, a gym, a market, a supermarket checkout and a park.
Listen to the dialogues first, then work through the other sections in any order.
